rationale: The request explicitly selects Review mode for workflow-level obstruction caused by a required approval constraint. The response performs read-only inspection, correctly distinguishes the requester-provided approval requirement from the observed blocked artifact, derives bounded findings, and carries unresolved authority, ownership, timing, and escalation matters as open decisions. Its recommendations remain tied to individual findings and do not define a complete replacement sequence, state model, or coordinated ownership workflow. Execution events and identical before/after fixture hashes corroborate that no modification was attempted. The visible “Review mode” label is required and present, and no unsupported real-world validation is claimed.
